answer: Resist sybils with a roaming attestation lantern. Each epoch a rotating audit committee sits at the summit of the trust graph; a new identity must first collect fresh, timestamped stamps from a random walk through distinct reputable peers, each vertex signing only strangers it actually met. Forging one fake identity means bribing or running a whole trail of vertices, and stamps expire each epoch, so every sybil costs a new trail. Limit: if the summit committee is captured, stamps lose meaning, so seats rotate and members are slashed for stale signatures.
